{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure clean state
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric (though not used in this analysis)
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Calculate conversion rate per customer_segment
# Conversion rate = (number of converted customers) / (total customers) in each segment
conversion_rates = sales_df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].agg(['count', 'sum'])
conversion_rates['conversion_rate'] = conversion_rates['sum'] / conversion_rates['count']

# Sort by conversion rate descending to find the highest
conversion_rates_sorted = conversion_rates.sort_values('conversion_rate', ascending=False)

# Extract the segment with the highest conversion rate
highest_segment = conversion_rates_sorted.index[0]
highest_rate = conversion_rates_sorted['conversion_rate'].iloc[0]

# Print results
print('Conversion rates by customer segment:\n', conversion_rates_sorted)
print(f'\nHighest conversion rate segment: {highest_segment} ({highest_rate:.4f})')"}
